```{r setup, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(VennDiagram)
  library(grid)
})

REPORT_ROOT <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/RNAfusion/FusionReports"

ARRIBA_CALLS <- file.path(REPORT_ROOT, "arriba.calls.high_medium.tsv")
FC_CALLS     <- file.path(REPORT_ROOT, "fusioncatcher.calls.kept.tsv")
SF_CALLS     <- file.path(REPORT_ROOT, "starfusion.calls.filtered.tsv")

OUT_PNG <- file.path(REPORT_ROOT, "venn_fusions_3callers.png")
OUT_PDF <- file.path(REPORT_ROOT, "venn_fusions_3callers.pdf")

```

```{r}
# ---- canonicalize fusion so A--B == B--A ----
canon_fusion <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x == "" | is.na(x)] <- NA_character_
  out <- vapply(x, function(f) {
    if (is.na(f)) return(NA_character_)
    if (!grepl("--", f, fixed = TRUE)) return(f)
    parts <- strsplit(f, "--", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    if (length(parts) < 2) return(NA_character_)
    g1 <- trimws(parts[1]); g2 <- trimws(paste(parts[-1], collapse="--"))
    if (g1 == "" && g2 == "") return(NA_character_)
    if (g1 == "") return(g2)
    if (g2 == "") return(g1)
    paste(sort(c(g1, g2)), collapse="--")
  }, character(1))
  out
}

read_calls <- function(path) {
  dt <- fread(path, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, data.table = TRUE)
  # Expect at least: sample, caller, fusion
  if (!("fusion" %in% names(dt))) stop("Missing column 'fusion' in: ", path)
  dt[, fusion_canon := canon_fusion(fusion)]
  dt <- dt[!is.na(fusion_canon) & fusion_canon != "--"]
  unique(dt$fusion_canon)
}

arriba_set <- read_calls(ARRIBA_CALLS)
fc_set     <- read_calls(FC_CALLS)
sf_set     <- read_calls(SF_CALLS)

venn_list <- list(
  Arriba = arriba_set,
  FusionCatcher = fc_set,
  `STAR-Fusion` = sf_set
)
```

```{r}
# ---- quick overlap numbers ----
cat("Set sizes:\n")
cat("  Unique_Arriba:", length(arriba_set), "\n")
cat("  Unique_FusionCatcher:", length(fc_set), "\n")
cat("  Unique_STAR-Fusion:", length(sf_set), "\n\n")

cat("Overlaps:\n")
cat("  Arriba ∩ FusionCatcher:", length(intersect(arriba_set, fc_set)), "\n")
cat("  Arriba ∩ STAR-Fusion:", length(intersect(arriba_set, sf_set)), "\n")
cat("  FusionCatcher ∩ STAR-Fusion:", length(intersect(fc_set, sf_set)), "\n")
cat("  All three:", length(Reduce(intersect, venn_list)), "\n\n")
```
```{r}
# ---- draw venn to screen ----
venn_plot <- venn.diagram(
  x = venn_list,
  filename = NULL,           # draw to current device
  main = "Fusion overlap across callers (cohort-level)",
  main.cex = 1.4,
  fill = c("#1b9e77", "#F8766D", "#00BFC4"),
  alpha = 0.5,
  cex = 1.1,
  cat.cex = 1.1,
  cat.col = "black",
  margin = 0.08,
  disable.logging = TRUE
)

grid.newpage()
grid.draw(venn_plot)

```
```{r}
# ---- save PNG ----
png(OUT_PNG, width = 1800, height = 1400, res = 200)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(venn_plot)
dev.off()

# ---- save PDF ----
pdf(OUT_PDF, width = 8, height = 6)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(venn_plot)
dev.off()

cat("Saved:\n  ", OUT_PNG, "\n  ", OUT_PDF, "\n", sep = "")
```
```{r}
OUT_ALL3 <- file.path(REPORT_ROOT, "fusions_in_all_3_callers.tsv")

# ---- fusions present in ALL THREE callers ----
all3 <- Reduce(intersect, venn_list)

cat("Fusions present in all 3 callers:", length(all3), "\n")

# Save as TSV
all3_dt <- data.table(Fusion = sort(all3))
fwrite(all3_dt, OUT_ALL3, sep = "\t")

cat("Saved 3-caller fusions to:\n  ", OUT_ALL3, "\n", sep = "")

```
